purpose: Determine whether the frozen structurally eligible SMP roster contains enough positive and negative population trajectories to identify trend symmetry before any component-composition or concentration outcome is opened.

input.panels: exact frozen roster emitted by the structural support gate
input.allowed_counts: component counts may be summed internally only to produce annual panel totals; component shares and E remain uncomputed/unexposed

annual_total.definition: sum of eligible mutually exclusive retained SiteID counts in complete panel-year t

trend.model: OLS slope log1p(N_it) ~ centered calendar year

outputs_allowed_before_concentration: counts of panels/species/MasterSites by trend class

decision.if_passed: Authorize one execution of the already-frozen trend-symmetry concentration contract.
decision.if_failed: Do not test increasing-versus-declining concentration symmetry. The SMP extract may still support a narrower abundance-space study only under a separately justified future contract, not as a rescue of this hypothesis.
